## <br>`r if (exists("TITLE", inherits = FALSE)) TITLE else "Espectros de Diseño"`

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
.SITE <- .currentTarget("siteID.target")
.STEM <- if (is.character(.SITE) && length(.SITE) == 1L) {
  paste0(tolower(.SITE), "-")
} else {
  ""
}
NGR::knitBlock(
  path = "/_fig/UHS.compare.ES.qmd",
  stem = paste0(.STEM, "uhs-compare"),
  labels = "rewrite",
  vars = list(
    siteID.target = .SITE,
    Vs30.target = 760,
    p.target = "mean"
  ),
  root = root
)
rm(list = intersect(c(
  ".SITE", ".STEM"
), ls()))
```
